name: The Hunter's Path
summary: The Hunter's Path is a rite of passage directing young orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill. Under the guidance of master hunter Thotar, fledgling trackers learn the vital discipline of binding wild predators to their will.

sections.title: A Hunter's Awakening
sections.body: Up to this point, an apprentice hunter in Durotar relies solely on their own bow and cunning. Tracking prey through red clay canyons and harsh scrubland teaches patience, but true mastery in the Horde requires bonding with the untamed fauna of the land. Class trainers recognize when a student has grown capable enough to walk this road, directing them straight to Razor Hill.

sections.title: The Master at Razor Hill
sections.body: Waiting at Razor Hill is Thotar, a veteran hunter steeped in the wild lore of Durotar. Thotar serves as the mentor who instructs novitiates in the perilous ritual of subduing ferocious beasts without breaking their spirit. Meeting him is the first step toward walking the wilderness with a loyal companion at one's side.

faq.q: What is the purpose of The Hunter's Path?
faq.answer: It serves as the introductory summons that sends orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill so they can begin their beast taming training.
Thotar is a seasoned hunter located in Razor Hill who oversees the trials required for young Horde trackers to bond with and command wild beasts.

faq.q: Why can't young hunters tame pets immediately?
aliases: why must hunters wait for pets
faq.answer: Controlling a dangerous predator requires deep discipline, patience, and specialized taming techniques. Until a hunter demonstrates basic survival skills, attempting to bind a wild beast would result in mauling or death.

faq.q: Which races undertake this specific trial?
aliases: is this for orcs and trolls only
faq.answer: This particular version of the path is meant for orcs and Darkspear trolls coming of age in Durotar, while tauren hunters undertake a similar trial in Mulgore.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Thotar?
faq.answer: Thotar immediately tasks the hunter with tracking down and subjugating various native predators across Durotar to prove their taming prowess.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The trial centers around Razor Hill, the primary settlement in central Durotar situated between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar.

angles.text: This summons marks the most defining threshold in your journey: moving from a lone marksman to a true master of beasts.
For orcs, partnering with a ferocious companion echoes ancient traditions that stretch back to the wolf riders of Draenor.
Darkspear hunters regard learning to tame local raptors and boars as essential for securing their footing in Durotar's treacherous wilds.
The Horde relies on its scouts and trackers to tame regional predators, turning the unforgiving ecology of Durotar into an asset.
